examples.text: Von den Imkern wird die fortpflanzungsfähige Bienenkönigin Weisel genannt.

„Ich habe dafür mehrere Beispiele angeführt und in einem Versuch mit einer Weisel von ‚Lasius bicornis‘ und einer ‚Lasius niger‘-Kolonie die Parallelen gezeigt, die die Ameisen in ihrem Verhalten zu dieser Weisel und zu ‚Claviger testaceus‘ zeigten.“

glosses: A reproductive female (especially the only one) in a colony of bees.

examples.text: It is generally believed that the queen bee mates only once in her lifetime.

glosses: The most important or dominant woman in an organization or situation.

examples.text: She wrote very generously to aspiring women writers, gave them good advice, took time to read their manuscripts and comments, and warmly applauded their successes. There is not a hint of the Queen Bee in the attitude toward other women writers.
She muttered to her mother, “There's that obnoxious redhead who thought she was the Queen Bee last year when she was a senior!”
